title: Jinki:Extend - Sorekara
justification: AniList 848 (OVA, 1 episode(s) from 2006-02-22) is AniDB 2742's special(s) S1, aired 2006-02-22. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 141, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 2742, and the special's title (And Then... / Sorekara) matches an AniList title. The parent's node, as overlay/2742.json patches it, places S1 on TVDB 0x1 And Then, 2006-02-22. TMDB 24856 has no season 0 (it files the episode as S1E13 And Then..., dated 2005-03-30), so there is no TMDB season 0 episode to compare.
